figures.name: mach_errors

figures.name: timing_bracket_widths

figures.name: encounter_brackets
figures.caption: Thick pale ends show recorded entry/exit brackets; narrow solid segments join first/last inside observations, not exact physical residence.

figures.name: uniform_transport
figures.caption: Physical flux probabilities define this independent ensemble reference. A fixed seed diagnostic does not prove RNG independence at research scales.

figures.name: negative_controls
figures.caption: Contact samples show a density change at constant pressure and velocity. Uniform/contact/empty fixtures emitted no events.

figures.name: restart_agreement
figures.caption: Replay from outside, active and pending-exit states preserved exact same-partition particle rows and event identities. No cross-rank claim.

figures.name: runtime_cost
figures.caption: Release Serial CPU, uniform flow, tlim=0.1. Startup, durable empty event chunks and output are included. These are laptop costs, not cluster budgets.

figures.name: output_cost
figures.caption: Actual directory sizes/counts exclude fluid and thermo output. Trace mode records every observation/transfer and is intended for small qualification jobs.

scope: Serial CPU double; planar thin 2D. One thin 3D heldout. No MPI/GPU/cluster timing.
